notes.title: How to Upgrade to PD Howler 11
notes.notes:
Hello!
PD Howler 11 has been released to Steam.

We are offering upgrade discounts to prior owners of PD Howler on Steam through bundles. At this time anyone who owns PD Howler 10 can upgrade to 11 with a 50% discount. An upgrade option for 9.6 users will be live soon. We hope you enjoy the new features!

PD Howler 10 Upgrade Bundle: 
http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3373/PD_Howler_10_Upgrade/

PD Howler 9.6 Upgrade Bundle: 
http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3408/PD_Howler_96_Upgrade/

notes.title: new Cityscapes brush media, now sets 1, 2 and 3 are available
notes.notes:
We have been creating brushes of city blocks and buildings. These are in freely available, downloadable zip files of brush media. 

http://www.thebest3d.com/cityscapes


We're hoping this will help. More to come. We're exploring and learning too along the way.

notes.title: PD Howler 10 is releasing tomorrow!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that PD Howler 10 is coming to Steam tomorrow! In honor of this we have lowered the price of PD Howler 9.6 to $39.99 permanently, and we will be having a 57% discount on PD Howler 10 for anyone who already owns PD Howler 9.6. This discount will be available for 2 weeks following launch.

Now down to the fun part, the top 10 new features of PD Howler 10:

[list]
    [*]New media browser
    [*]New color picker
    [*]New undo system
    [*]Foliage enhancements
    [*]Block interpolation
    [*]More memory efficient
    [*]Modernized GUI
    [*]Autosave/crash recovery
    [*]Cinemascopic filter
    [*]Simplified brush size[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/415140/

Thanks for your continued support.
